about_the_game:
Welcome to Spacelane Express — a gritty space-trucking adventure where every shipment counts, every jump risks ambush, and every port tells a story.

You are an independent pilot carving a path through the frontier — running cargo, upgrading your ship, taking odd jobs, and surviving the corporate-ruled void. Behind the hum of engines lies a living economy, shifting prices, and rival haulers competing for the same lanes.

✨ Key Features

  • Space Trucker RPG – Trade goods, fulfill contracts, and build your reputation across the galaxy.

  • Dynamic Economy – Prices rise and fall as stations run short or flood markets.

  • Ship Customization – equip engines, shields, and turrets

  • Tab Targeting Combat – Engage pirates and raiders without manual aiming

  • Exploration & Discovery – Uncover derelicts, outposts, and alien remnants scattered through deep space.

  • Early Access – Core systems are playable: trading, combat, and exploration. More quests, ships, and stations are planned for upcoming updates.

⚙️ Development Status

This is an Early Access release. We’re building the universe with player feedback — expect frequent updates adding new systems, ports, factions, and story events. The goal is a fully-realized open-space RPG where every pilot’s route tells a different story.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Haul cargo, dodge pirates, and chase contracts across the far reaches of space. Spacelane Express is a space-trucker RPG blending trading, exploration, and ship combat in a ever changing sci-fi world.
